open_points: STATUS: GD-02, FIT-G9 and 2.1.2 are pending (design-pending-B4); the 24 Nov counts are leads, not solid, so every record here is provisional true.

Match derivation: doubling the band in force gives 4 to 14 a frame at 15:00 and 8 to 20 at 17:00, below GD-02's event range of 15 to 25; the file derives as the rule says, the design should decide whether the match band is raised.

The measuring lane's crowd-count rows of 24 Nov (production/research/lane/measurements/) are not in the repository: only DECIDES-CHECK-2026-11-24.md (a plan) and DEFINITIONS line 77, which quotes the builder's row of 24 Nov 09:46 (busiest daytime streets about 5 to 10 in view in KCD2 and RDR2, middle about 6, quiet 0 to 3). Those figures are recorded under measured_frame_check on the parade and the quiet zones. Every other band is provisional until the rows land.

G9's parade front is 100 m on both pavements; it is read as Quay Street's 48 built metres only (map.json quay_street is 57.1 m). Back Parade has its own band and is never summed in. The G9 stretch figures are kept as given, so they are dense for 48 m.

Clock: any real-time figure here is on 120 s a game hour. The repeat gap of KCD2's pool (32 s, a file-read lead) is matched by 16 game minutes (32 real seconds); the old 60 s clock would have made it 32 game minutes.
The 1990 pavement study (CLOUD-FIGURES B4, who walked a Humber port's pavements by hour) is still owed; the hour bands are the design's.

Step-aside distance and timing are owed from reference footage (DEFINITIONS 2.x, 26 to 28 Nov). tune.json crowd.avoid_radius_m, crowd.step_aside_time_s, crowd.look_before_step_s, crowd.spawn_min_distance_m are null there; this file keeps them null and owed, and gives a chosen working spawn distance separately.

G9 first pass counts (25 to 35 busy) and design pass 4 (12 to 20) differ; pass 4 is followed. street-wear.json holds wall wear decals only, so the look tables come from the plain-1990-clothes note and the clothes' floor; Jafar's ruling of 1 Oct (no trainers, no contrast stitching) is followed for every extra.
Bonfire, remembrance, chapel and market-peak counts are chosen; the design gives only 'double at 15:00 and 17:00', 'chapel is busy' and 'market 15 to 25'.

ev_coldstore_in and ev_coldstore_out overlap on purpose: the map says the shift leaves at half past five; the arrival is a chosen mirror. The cold store second shift change runs Mon-Fri only (Saturday close 13:00).
The bus stop moved to (116.4, 34.5) in map.json; this file keys it by id bus_stop_qs only.

count_kinds.per_frame: people in one camera frame at the default 86-degree view; settled design counts (GD-02): busy 4 to 10, other daytime 2 to 7, quiet streets at night 0 to 2, market and match 15 to 25. About half stand or sit at a made place (tune crowd.at_made_place_share_min 0.4 is the test floor), groups of 2 to 3 facing in.
count_kinds.per_stretch: people on a stretch, both pavements. Parade front: the whole 98.2 m (G9). Every other zone: people per 100 m of its own road. A frame holds fewer than a stretch.

weather_and_day_modifiers.rain_note: G9: rain halves each band, frame and stretch, rounded up for the max and down for the min; tune/light-weather crowd_factor must read 0.5 for rain. Drizzle uses the light-weather profile's own crowd_factor if it differs.

witnesses.rule: RT2-10: a crowd extra who catches any slot of a deed becomes a kept person with a fixed face, coat and home (a terrace in the Hook, or a district at the soft edge) and a routine from these hour windows, saved with the town
witnesses.keeps_for: permanent memory; after 7 game days with no open matter he lives at the soft edge and comes into the Hook only on his routine's days; the police can still find and ask him
witnesses.hold_off: a witness-held extra is never despawned in view (despawn.never_while)

content_gate.enforcement_site: crowd generation is one of canon's six enforcement sites
generator_must_refuse: any age under 18: no child, infant, pushchair with a child, pupil or school uniform, in any look, group or witness
anyone with alcohol, a glass of drink, a bottle, a can, or at a pub, off-licence or bar; the boarded pub (lm_old_pub) stays shut with nobody at it
anyone betting, with a betting slip, at a fruit machine, bingo, raffle, pools coupon or any gambling place
signs, props or lines aimed at children; the old school (lm_school) has no one in or at it
real people, real brands, logos, crests or slogans on clothes (the match scarf is the invented club's)
anything after 1992: trainers, slim or stitched denim, hoodies, branded sportswear, mobile phones, earphones
allowed: tea, a mug or a flask, chip-shop parcels
content_gate.check: after generation, assert every spawned record has age >= 18 and look ids from look_tables.looks only; fail the build otherwise
